``cascade=false`` (default), direct children climb up to this node's
parent so the tree stays connected.

delete.description:
Purge user data from all local stores.

When ``deleteWdk=false`` (default): non-WDK chats are hard-deleted,
WDK-linked chats are **dismissed** so WDK sync won't re-import them.
The strategies remain on VEuPathDB but PathFinder ignores them.

When ``deleteWdk=true``: everything is hard-deleted locally AND all
WDK strategies are deleted from VEuPathDB.

Always deletes: gene sets, experiments, control sets.

Pass ``?siteId=X`` to limit to one site, or omit for everything.

Typed body for ``POST /api/v1/chat`` (AI SDK v6 + PathFinder extras).

The shape matches ``@ai-sdk/react``'s ``useChat`` submit payload
(``trigger``, ``id``, ``messages``) with PathFinder-scoped fields

via ``body`` on the client transport. The authenticated user UUID still
comes from the ``pathfinder-auth`` cookie.
